title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows + bump actions/node deps for hygiene
author: Ava Patel
release_notes: Consolidates CI workflows for lint/test/release, upgrades GitHub Actions and Node versions for build images. No user-facing changes.
description:
Motivation: Our org has accumulated a large number of slightly divergent GitHub Actions workflows for linting, unit/integration tests, and release automation. This causes noisy CI runs, duplicated setup steps, and makes maintaining action versions and caching policies error-prone. This PR unifies lint/test/release job patterns into a small set of composable workflows, standardizes Node and container build images, and updates a number of GH Actions to their supported versions.

Summary of changes: consolidated workflows -> .github/workflows/{lint.yml,test.yml,release.yml} using reusable workflows; standardized matrix for Node 18/20 builds where relevant; introduced a shared actions/cache key helper and centralized setup-node usage; bumped major GH Actions where safe (setup-node, actions/checkout, cache actions) and removed an old deprecated action; simplified job dependencies to reduce unnecessary parallelism and improve cache hit rates; adjusted the release workflow to be more conservative (tag on release branch + protective checks) and added an additional dry-run step for automation safety.

Checklist: - [x] Consolidate duplicate steps into reusable workflows - [x] Bump GH Actions to recent stable releases and update pinning where appropriate - [x] Ensure lint jobs run on changed files and key PR paths to save cycles - [x] Validate unit/integration test matrices still cover supported runtimes - [x] Add a dry-run for release automation to avoid accidental publishes - [x] Run full CI in feature branch and address flakes observed

Impacts & risk: This is primarily CI infra refactor + deps bump; it touches release automation so we exercised dry-run and manual approvals. There are small risk vectors around e2e flakiness due to reduced parallelism and changed caching behavior; we ran the full matrix twice and observed consistent results. If anything goes wrong we can revert the workflow files (self-contained) or pin a previous action version.

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps workflow logic backwards-compatible with existing protected branches. Follow-up work (ENG-4300) will add more caching heuristics and per-repo overrides for large monorepo packages.

Ava Patel (author): Increased timeout from 10m to 25m for e2e firefox and added one automatic rerun on failure for the e2e job. Observed stability improvement in CI runs.
